```plato

    //==
    // # CircularSector
    //
    // A pie slice. Precondition throughout: Sweep is stored forward and spans at
    // most one full turn. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circular_sector

    // Half the bisector direction of the sweep, as a unit displacement.
    SweepBisector(sweep: AngleInterval): Vector2D
    {
        var mid = sweep.Start + sweep.Extent * 0.5;
        return (mid.Cos, mid.Sin);
    }
```
